speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; can you tell me when these symptoms first started and if they have progressed over time? Do you experience any other neurological issues like weakness, numbness, or speech difficulties?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision or loss of color perception, and do you experience any numbness or tingling in your hands or feet? REQUEST TEST: Vitamin_B12_Level, TSH, Syphilis_Serology

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any recent episodes of confusion, personality changes, or memory loss in addition to the clumsiness? Are you taking any specific medications or supplements regularly?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy. REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_MRI_with_contrast.
